name: Bank single-balance-authority regression
description: A bank mutation must update the account exactly once; the receipt and subsequent balance read must agree.

tests.name: Deposit receipt and persisted balance agree

value.sql_int: SELECT balance FROM bank_accounts WHERE owner_type='player' AND owner_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='bank_authority_player') AND currency='CRD' AND is_active=TRUE

tests.name: Balance read matches the committed receipt
